Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Uniparts India reported its Q4 and FY26 financial results, highlighting a revenue growth of 21% for the full year and robust fourth-quarter performance driven by volume growth and an improving global agriculture and construction equipment cycle. Management noted that the company is net debt-free with a strong net cash position and that new business wins in the trailing 12 months exceeded INR225 crores. The company addressed operational disruptions including a facility fire in Ludhiana and West Asian supply chain uncertainties, while affirming confidence in delivering healthy growth and sustainable margins above 20% in FY27. Uniparts India reported its Q4 FY26 and full year financial results, highlighting strong revenue and profit growth driven by improving global agriculture and construction equipment cycles. Management noted sequential order book strengthening and performance ahead of previous guidance.

guidance.claim: Overall growth in FY27 is expected to be in line with FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle and execution of recent business wins.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: The small agriculture segment in North America is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

guidance.claim: Management stated that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle and expects to operate comfortably above that level as volumes build through FY27.
guidance.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle. And as volumes build through FY27, we expect to operate comfortably above that level.

guidance.claim: Management noted that full year FY26 revenues grew by 21% over FY25 against an earlier guidance of mid teens growth.
guidance.quote: For the full year FY26, revenues grew by 21% over FY25 against a guidance of mid teens growth.

guidance.claim: The company expects to close the full year with mid-teens revenue growth.
guidance.quote: We remain committed to closing the full year with the mid-teens growth, right, and this is consistent with the outlook as we have reiterated over the past three quarters.

guidance.claim: Management states that a 20% EBITDA margin profile is sustainable over the cycle.
guidance.quote: So, this reinforces our confidence that a 20% EBITDA margin profile is sustainable over the cycle.

demand_outlook.claim: The final quarter of FY26 provided further evidence that the global agriculture and construction equipment cycle is turning.
demand_outlook.quote: The final quarter of FY26 provided further evidence that the global agriculture and construction equipment cycle is turning.

demand_outlook.claim: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with the second half being better than the first half.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: In Europe, the construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of '26.
demand_outlook.quote: Specifically coming to Europe, the construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of '26.

demand_outlook.claim: Sequential expectations are for Q1 to be in line with Q4, and the second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half.
demand_outlook.quote: Therefore, sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4. And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.

demand_outlook.claim: In North America, customers commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY2027 for construction equipment.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers’ commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY2027 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first.

demand_outlook.claim: In Europe, the small agriculture market is showing early signs of stabilisation after a prolonged period of softening.
demand_outlook.quote: In Europe, the small agriculture market is showing early signs of stabilisation after a prolonged period of softening.

demand_outlook.claim: Large agriculture continues to work through the current down-cycle, with leading OEMs affirming that Q4 FY2026 represents the cyclical trough.
demand_outlook.quote: Large agriculture continues to work through the current down-cycle, with leading OEMs affirming that Q4 FY2026 represents the cyclical trough.

demand_outlook.claim: Overall, the aftermarket business expects growth in FY27 to be in line with FY26 growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall we expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with FY26 growth, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business wins and a gradual recovery across end markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Construction activity in the United States continues to be underpinned by infrastructure spending, data center investments, and energy transition projects.
demand_outlook.quote: The construction activity continues to be underpinned by infrastructure spending, investment in data centers, and energy transition projects.

demand_outlook.claim: In Europe, the construction market is expected to remain stable with modest improvement through the year 2026.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, the European construction market is expected to remain stable with modest improvement through current year '26.

demand_outlook.claim: Small agriculture demand in India remains robust, supported by favorable monsoons, healthy reservoir levels, GST reductions, and steady farmer sentiment.
demand_outlook.quote: In India, demand remains robust supported by favorable monsoons, healthy reservoir levels, GST reductions, and steady farmer sentiment.

demand_outlook.claim: In North America, the rate of decline in large agriculture has moderated materially, with current expectations indicating a 15% to 20% contraction.
demand_outlook.quote: Say, for example, in North America, the rate of decline has moderated materially with current expectations indicating a 15%-20% contraction, which is a meaningful improvement over the year 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% in Q4 FY26 and a 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: A brief on the financial position for quarter 4 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: The trailing 12-month EPS performance accounts for a INR3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.
margins_costs.quote: This performance actually accounts for INR3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.

margins_costs.claim: For Q3 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 21.5%.
margins_costs.quote: For Q3 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 21.5%.

margins_costs.claim: The trailing 12-month EPS post-Q3 results is Rs. 28.80 after accounting for a Rs. 3.4 crores impact from the new wage code.
margins_costs.quote: In fact, the trailing 12-month EPS post-Q3 results is Rs.28.80 and this is after accounting for a Rs.3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.

orders_capacity.claim: Order books strengthened sequentially compared to quarter 3 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Order books strengthened sequentially compared to the quarter 3 FY26, although the pace of recovery varied across geographies and industry segments.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing 12-month business wins exceeded INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% quarter-on-quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: So if I talk about the strategic outlook, our new business momentum actually has gained meaningful traction with trailing 12-month business wins exceeding INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: New business momentum has gained meaningful traction, with trailing twelve month wins exceeding INR 225 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our new business momentum has gained meaningful traction, with trailing twelve month wins exceeding INR 225 crores — growing over 12.5% quarter on quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The new business awards pipeline stands at approximately Rs. 200 crores in annualized potential over the last 12 months.
orders_capacity.quote: Our new business awards pipeline remains to be strong at approximately Rs.200 crores, providing good visibility into future growth across segments and geographies.

orders_capacity.claim: Warehouse-led sales account for over 50% of revenues in the first nine months of FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Importantly, warehouse-led sales now account for over 50% of revenues in the first nine months of FY26, which is where we create the highest value of our customers through agility, resilience, and proximity.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to be net debt-free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores, and total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores. In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

capital_allocation.claim: During Q3 FY26, the company declared a special dividend of Rs. 101 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Let me also mention that during Q3 FY26, the company declared a special dividend of Rs.101 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company announced a second interim dividend of Rs. 7.
capital_allocation.quote: We have in fact also announced a dividend of Rs.7, a second interim yesterday.

risks_headwinds.claim: Towards the end of quarter 3, one of the facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incident in the finishing shop.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariffs had some short-term impact on the aftermarket business.
risks_headwinds.quote: While tariffs had some short-term impact, the structural fundamentals of the aftermarket remain intact and diversification across regions and customer segments provide additional resilience.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fire occurred on December 27, 2025, in a factory in Ludhiana, impacting the surface finishing area of the plant.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, on the 27th of December 2025, we had a fire in one of our factories in Ludhiana, which impacted the surface finishing area of the plant.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects normal operations from the fire-affected Ludhiana facility to return on schedule.
management_commitments.quote: We expect normal operations to return on schedule.

management_commitments.claim: Rebuilding efforts for the Ludhiana facility are underway to be online by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: So, Sunil, the efforts are underway to rebuild and to be online by the end of the year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects normalcy regarding the Ludhiana facility rebuilding to be restored on schedule.
management_commitments.quote: We expect normalcy to be restored on schedule.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects Q1 aftermarket business to be in line with Q4.
management_commitments.quote: Sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4 and overall we expect H2 FY27 to be stronger than H1 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects growth in FY27 to be in line with FY26 growth for the aftermarket business.
management_commitments.quote: Overall we expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with FY26 growth, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business wins and a gradual recovery across end markets.

management_commitments.claim: The company is committed to closing the full year with mid-teens revenue growth.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to closing the full year with the mid-teens growth, right, and this is consistent with the outlook as we have reiterated over the past three quarters.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
